T: Double booked. Don't go in the basement.
D: A woman arrives at her Detroit rental to find a stranger already staying there, and then she finds the basement.
P: Serve the tea when Keith makes Tess a cup on that first night.
S: Keith's tea and brown butter shortbread
the stranger in the rental makes her tea

Brown butter shortbread fingers with a sprinkle of sea salt and demerara, served with a pot of strong black tea, milk and sugar on the side. Melt 200g butter and cook until it smells nutty and goes golden brown, then chill until firm but soft. Beat with 90g caster sugar until pale, then mix in 250g plain flour, 30g cornflour and a pinch of salt. Press into a lined 20cm square tin, sprinkle with demerara and flaky salt, prick all over and bake at 160C for 35 minutes. Cut into fingers while warm. Brew a pot of black tea for 4 minutes and serve alongside.
Rental kitchen salami and cheddar toasties
whatever's in a short-stay rental kitchen

Crisp toasted sandwiches of salami, sharp cheddar and pickles on buttered sourdough, cut into fingers with a pot of hot English mustard. Butter one side of 8 slices of sourdough. On the unbuttered side of 4 slices, layer 50g grated sharp cheddar, 4 slices salami and a few sliced pickles, then more cheese, and top with the remaining bread, buttered side out. Cook in a pan over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and melted. Cut into fingers and serve with hot English mustard.
Welcome basket baked brie, honey walnuts
the double-booked rental on Barbary Street

A whole brie baked until molten, topped with honey, toasted walnuts, thyme and chilli flakes, with crisp baguette toasts and apple slices for dipping. Heat the oven to 180C. Score the top of a 200g brie and sit it on a lined tray. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until soft in the middle. Toast 40g walnuts in a dry pan and toss with 2 tbsp honey, thyme leaves and a pinch of chilli flakes. Slice a baguette thin, brush with oil and bake for 8 minutes until crisp. Spoon the walnuts over the brie and serve with the toasts and sliced apple.
M: Dough pressed into an oiled rectangular tin, cubed brick cheese or mozzarella and cheddar right to the edges, pepperoni, baked at 250C for 15 minutes, tomato sauce striped on top after.
LA galbi short ribs with kimchi rice
the actor back in LA before everything catches up with him

Thin-cut beef short ribs marinated in soy, pear, garlic and sesame, seared on a smoking grill, with kimchi fried rice, lettuce cups and ssamjang. Blend half a nashi pear, 1 small onion, 5 garlic cloves, 100ml soy sauce, 2 tbsp brown sugar and 2 tbsp sesame oil. Marinate 1.2kg thin-cut LA-style beef short ribs for at least 4 hours. Grill over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes a side until charred. Fry 200g chopped kimchi in oil, add 600g cooked cold rice and 1 tbsp gochujang and stir-fry until crisp. Serve with cos leaves, sliced spring onion, sesame seeds and ssamjang.
W: Dates soaked with bicarb, beaten into a butter sponge, baked at 180C for 30 minutes, drowned in hot toffee sauce.
K: a glass to settle the nerves on that first awkward night

Red wine steeped with orange, apple, cinnamon and a dash of brandy, topped with lemonade and poured over ice into mismatched rental glasses. In a large jug, combine a 750ml bottle of medium-bodied red, 60ml brandy, 2 tbsp caster sugar, 1 sliced orange, 1 diced apple and 1 cinnamon stick. Stir to dissolve the sugar and chill for at least 2 hours. Just before serving, add plenty of ice and top with 300ml lemonade. Pour into glasses with some of the fruit in each.

m.how: Press 600g pizza dough into an oiled rectangular tin and prove 30 minutes. Cover right to the edges with 200g cubed mozzarella and 150g cheddar, add 100g pepperoni and bake at 250C for 15 minutes. Stripe tomato sauce simmered with garlic on top.

w.how: Soak 200g chopped dates in 250ml boiling water with 1 tsp bicarb. Beat 80g butter with 150g brown sugar and 2 eggs, fold in 175g self-raising flour and the dates. Bake at 180C for 30 minutes. Pour over sauce of 100g butter, 150g brown sugar and 200ml cream.
